summary: Customer requested to change loan EMI date, agent provided details.

intents.keywords: Mera loan ka EMI date change kaise ...

issues.issue: Customer wants to change the EMI date of their loan.

intents.actions of agent: Agent explained the process of submitting a request form and offered online and branch options.
intents.Process Request: Agent will send details of online and branch options via email.
intents.resolution: Agent provided information on how to change the EMI date and the associated charges.

intents.intent: Inquiry about processing time and charges
intents.keywords: Kitna time lagega aur koi charge hai?
intents.actions of agent: Agent informed about the processing time (5-7 days) and the nominal charge (200 rupees).
intents.resolution: Agent provided the processing time and charge details.
